story:
Edit this 3x3 production book-cover atlas. Preserve its exact grid (3 columns,3 rows,full bleed,no gutters), original 9 distinct editorial art styles, typography quality, all exact Korean titles, palettes, publisher marks, and rich original art. Change the IMAGE SUBJECTS so each cover meaningfully expresses its reading-achievement TITLE AND ACTUAL CONDITION. Do not turn them into uniform icons, do not unify the design styles. No 3D covers, no new headings or captions. Keep all lettering readable inside cell. Maintain crisp flat print artwork.
Cell1 단숨에: KEEP orange/ultramarine fast slanted expressive lettering, already means finishing in one sitting.
Cell2 벽돌책 완독: KEEP classic-library half-image/half-ivory typography and engraving medium, but replace generic mountain with a detailed antique ENGRAVING of a monumental very thick volume whose page layers form a steep stepped mountain; a tiny human reader stands on last page at summit, evoking conquering >500 pages. Engraved narrative image, NOT an isolated flag/book pictogram.
Cell3 작가 덕질: KEEP warm sepia photographic biography style and elegant ivory serif, but REPLACE arbitrary woman's portrait with original PHOTOGRAPH of a writer's desk with THREE coordinated same-author volumes, handwritten drafts and a pen in warm lamplight, no face or named real author, no fake cover text. Three volumes is the key (same author3books). Rich photographic composition.
Cell4 마침내 완독: KEEP chalk-white minimalist cover, fine coral-red serif title and hairline rule, but REPLACE generic flower circle photograph with a small artfully cropped PHOTO of a well-kept book open at its LAST PAGE, a long ribbon bookmark and slightly dusty page edges in warm afternoon light, with a tiny dried pressed leaf suggesting a long wait. Avoid any printed numbers/actual quoted text. The small round image window stays; this is finishing after a year, not flowers.
Cell5 다시 펼친 책: KEEP expressive cozy oil/gouache painting with vermilion chair, blue window and warm lamp, but add a visibly well-loved book in foreground gently reopened by a pair of hands at a creased familiar page, several past page folds. Re-reading a familiar book is the narrative, not merely a room.
Cell6 인생책 발견: KEEP airy warm-white framed illustration layout and calm teal serif title; REPLACE generic beach landscape with an original watercolor scene of a reader in a quiet library reaching for ONE distinctly coral-red volume glowing in warm light among many subdued gray/blue books. This is finding one uniquely treasured book, not generic travel. Refined artistic scene, not icon.
Cell7 한 줄 평론가: KEEP big quotation mark / black-and-ivory editorial type / red rule. Make the single red rule underline exactly ONE short abstract handwritten-style review line, no additional review prose or fabricated quote. Emphasizes writing a one-line review.
Cell8 약속 지킴: KEEP original friendly horse-and-round-bird hand-drawn illustration and butter yellow notebook cover, green hand-lettered title cartouche. Now characters celebrate together over a completed reading-plan JOURNAL with all small grid boxes filled and a short stack of finished books; small high-five/fist-bump-like celebration between them, no copyrighted characters. Promise = completing annual reading target. Not an isolated checkmark badge.
Cell9 취향 발견: KEEP contemporary abstract multicolor geometric art-book cover and clean lower white title band. Rearrange the upper shapes into a sophisticated abstract SIDE PROFILE assembled from diverse book-page-like colored rectangles and curved taste-map segments, so discovering a reader's own preference identity is apparent; no generic arbitrary circles, no clock, no scanning/magnifier pictogram. Modernist editorial artwork, not app icon.
All9 titles remain exactly: 단숨에 / 벽돌책 완독 / 작가 덕질 / 마침내 완독 / 다시 펼친 책 / 인생책 발견 / 한 줄 평론가 / 약속 지킴 / 취향 발견. Same production atlas geometry. Preserve high finish.
companion:
Edit this exact 3x4 flat production atlas, preserving12equal full-bleed cells, no margins/gutters, palettes, all existing exact Korean titles, tiny imprints, original varied editorial DESIGN STYLES. Update image subjects for semantic relevance to achievement conditions. No 3D book mockups or icons, no awards/fake factual copy. Exact count12cells, title safety margins8%.
Row1Cell1 책장: preserve classic edition oil-painting upper35% +ivory title/lower blank area, but replace bouquet emphasis with a beautiful actual READING COLLECTION: varied book spines and well-organized stacked volumes under an antique library lamp. Remove large flowers. Keep LOWER CENTRAL35% blank ivory for live milestone number, DO NOT print a number. Means total completed books.
Row1Cell2 넓은 시야: preserve painterly travel-atlas/blue-serifs style but replace ordinary harbor with an original beautiful unfolding PAPER ATLAS COLLAGE containing a botanical study, star chart and literary city map connected across pages, showing several reading fields. Not generic globe icon. Keep bottom-right small calm light space for live milestone numeral, print no numbers.
Row1Cell3 0127의 날: KEEP elegant black01/27 and red의날 typography unchanged. Exact date is the condition.
Row2Cell1 새해 첫 책: preserve airy watercolor-novel jacket, navy title and warm sky; depict a quiet winter morning reading desk by window, first golden sunrise over snowy village, pristine book opened for the first time and a little desk calendar showing ONLY a large '1'. New Year's Day reading, no fake year, no sun pictogram. Painterly, not photographic.
Row2Cell2 하루 두 권: preserve photographic diptych+red-brown title band, replace unrelated coffee/manuscript diptych with TWO distinct BOOKS finished at same desk at different times on the SAME DAY: left warm morning light, a blue volume with marker on last page; right evening lamplight, a red volume with marker on last page. Photo-based, tasteful realistic narrative, no book/check icon.
Row2Cell3 솔직한 독자: preserve quiet ivory thin-serifs/red hand mark. Replace the eye sketch with a small hand-marked editorial rating slip showing FIVE outlined stars with ONLY ONE filled red star; precisely1 of5. It means first honest one-star rating. Integrate it as printed marginalia/book-jacket composition, not a giant app icon. No extra prose.
Row3Cell1 얇지만 깊은: preserve subtle gray/navy conceptual-poetry design and title, replace architecture section with a fine original conceptual illustration of a VERY SLIM VOLUME whose thin outline at top casts an unexpectedly DEEP indigo paper-shadow into a long vertical well. Thin book, deep impact (<=150pages and5stars), no numerals needed, no giant star.
Row3Cell2 신간 발견: preserve orange/black graphic pinstripe/condensed type design. Add one subtle torn-back fresh PRINTED PAPER WRAPPER strip integrated into typography, exposing clean pale paper underneath, like a newly published book. Keep title readable, no magnifier/icon/false 'bestseller' claims.
Row3Cell3 책에 관한 책: preserve red conceptual-line editorial design and title, but make nested paper planes clearly suggest A BOOK COVER containing another smaller book cover recursively, elegantly drawn fine red printing lines. This is a book about books, no generic star or badge.
Row4Cell1 세 번째 만남: preserve archival cream/rust literary serif / tactile paper style, replace unrelated pressed leaves with an original warm archival PHOTO/COLLAGE of the SAME beloved worn volume appearing in THREE small overlapping reading snapshots, with3distinct bookmark ribbons and gentle worn page edges, creating three encounters with same book. No arrow pictogram, no fake authors.
Row4Cell2 아직 쓰이지 않은 이야기: KEEP gray neutral mystery jacket unchanged. It must reveal no condition.
Row4Cell3 blankcream unused: KEEP blank.
Do not replace the visual styles with uniform big type. Maintain real bookstore richness: painting, concept illustration, photography, restrained typographic editions, fine printed diagrams. Exact Korean titles. Production atlas only.
